title: Galois theory, automorphism groups of prime models, and the Picard-Vessiot closure
summary: We work in the context of a complete totally transcendental theory $T = T^{eq}$. We consider the prime model $M_{A}$ over a set $A$. For intermediate sets $B$ with $A\subseteq B \subseteq M_{A}$ which are normal ($Aut(M_{A}/A)$-invariant) and ``minimal" we give a full Galois correspondence between intermediate definably closed sets $A\subseteq B \subseteq M_{A}$ and ``closed" subgroups of $Aut(B/A)$ (the group of $A$-elementary permutations of $B$).
